segments.title: Say hello like Priya!
segments.say: Say hello like Priya, from Jaipur, India!

segments.title: Namaste means I bow to you
segments.say: In Hindi, she says, {hi:नमस्ते।} It means, I bow to you.

segments.title: How to do it
segments.say: Press your palms together, fingers up, and give a small bow.

segments.title: For family, guests and friends
segments.say: It's a kind, respectful hello for family, guests, and new friends.

segments.title: SEND THIS
segments.say: Send this to someone you'd say namaste to, and follow for a new word.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
segments.tiny: A new kid, a new language
